components.name: SOAP second moment (exp_avg_sq: EMA of squared momentum in the eigenbasis)
SOAP Kronecker factors (row_gg = EMA of GGᵀ, col_gg = EMA of GᵀG)

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding, LM head and 1-D params
notes: All SOAP state is fp32 and dominated by the 3072×3072 side factor and basis of each MLP matrix (4× the matrix each); the eigenbases are created by eigh after the first update and soap_basis_qr's re-sorted copies are transient. NorMuon-lite's per-row/column vectors are O(rows) and ignored.
evidence: Muon.__init__: soap_params = {p for n, p in named_params if n.endswith('.mlp.fc.weight') or n.endswith('.mlp.proj.weight')}
Muon.step: state["momentum"] = torch.zeros_like(p) for every block matrix (model.blocks.parameters() with ndim >= 2)

Muon.step (p in self.soap_params): state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=torch.float32); state["row_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(0), p.size(0)); state["col_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(1), p.size(1))
soap_update_preconditioner: state["q_row"/"q_col"] = soap_eigenbasis(row_gg/col_gg) (eigh, set after the first update), replaced by soap_basis_qr every 10 SOAP steps
Muon.step: state["second_moment"] = torch.zeros((*p.shape[:-1], 1)) or (1, n): NorMuon-lite vector, O(rows), ignored
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight], [proj.weight], [p for p in model.parameters() if p.ndim < 2], fused=True): exp_avg + exp_avg_sq per param
